limitations: ALFRED vintage dates are when FRED took the data in. They trail the BTS release by days or weeks, so a replay keyed on them is slightly kinder to the forecaster than the real wait. The report says so.
ALFRED vintages for this series begin in October 2014, so the development years of the earlier study cannot be replayed.
One observation step is not a publication date simulation. Each target is already underway when its origin vintage appears.
72 dependent months on one national index and seven component series are not a general result. No significance tests and no winner selected after outcomes.
The study does not change the serving model, its features or its gate.
